translation: Yawe b'a fɔ Yoshuwa ma ko: “Cidenw bɛ seerew bolo, n'u ye aw jiko, u na bɔ kɔnɔ na.” Nka a ma o fɔ — sariya in kɔrɔta ko: “Aw b'i bila sarakalasebagaw ma, minnu bɛ ⟨את⟩ seerefɛɛrɛnɛɛ (adomidenw) ta, ka bɔ Yarden (Yardenni) na.” — n'a ma tiɲɛ. Sariya in kɔrɔta kɔrɔ ye: “K'a fɔ sarakalasebagaw ma, minnu b'⟨את⟩ sɛbɛn mara, u ka bɔ Yarden na.”
